general-ex-equilibrium.rationale: Independent referee checked Murota 2022 Theorems 6.1(9) and 9.4 against the paper reduction. Finite real-valued EX valuations extend to binary-domain M-natural-concave functions; finite convolution never equals +infinity; the singleton-domain indicator intersects the convolution at the all-ones vector, so the real-valued intersection theorem yields a supporting price. A zero-value dummy employer converts that price into nonnegative common wages with zero wages for unassigned workers. The equilibrium allocation and employer-profit/wage dual have equal objectives, proving existence of an integral configuration-LP optimum. This resolves the proof obstacle only, not novelty or welfare.
